title: Human
html:
Humans are a playable race in Baldur's Gate 3. They are one of the most populous races in Faerûn, exhibiting a versatile range of skills rather than any one mastery.

“
The most common face in Faerûn, humans are known for their tenacity, creativity, and endless capacity for growth.
„
— In-game racial description

About humans

Humans are the most widespread and adaptable people of Faerûn, defined by ambition and versatility rather than ancient tradition. Their short lives drive them to achieve greatness quickly, producing heroes, tyrants, scholars, and explorers in equal measure. Culturally diverse and endlessly resourceful, humans found kingdoms, forge alliances, and reshape history. They reflect this flexibility by excelling in any role through determination and balance rather than singular strength.

Human Versatility
Select an additional Skill to be Proficient in. Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.

Bugs

  • Sound effects are completely missing from nine melee attack animation types used by Human Body Type 4. These animations affect usage with the following weapons:
    • Attacks with a  Javelin with and without an equipped  Shield (item)
    • Attacks with a  Quarterstaff
    • Attacks with a  Spear with and without an equipped  Shield (item)
    • Attacks with a  Glaive,  Halberd,  Pike, or  Trident
    • All main-hand attacks with a ⁠Slashing weapon while dual-wielding another weapon in the off-hand
    • All off-hand attacks with a ⁠Piercing weapon
    • All off-hand attacks with a ⁠Slashing weapon
